item.title: Apollo v4.0.0
item.description:
Apollo 4.0.0 | Apollo-Reborn-4.0.0
### Features
- Add **iPhone Duo** support with layouts that adapt to the closed display, open portrait, open landscape and partially folded positions, using the existing Apollo Reborn builds (#1245: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Browse a feed beside its comments, choose Original or Focused content widths, and open the subreddit list in a Standard or Liquid Glass panel - Inbox, Account and Settings gain sidebar/detail layouts in open landscape, while Search can keep results beside the page you open - Pixel Pals is unavailable on Duo; regular iPhones keep it - Add an optional **iPad Layout (Beta)** on iPadOS 18 and later, with a native sidebar, adjustable feed and reader columns, and full-width Gallery View (#1385: @jordanearle) - Try it from the one-time invitation or turn on iPad Layout under Interface; quit and reopen Apollo to apply it, or turn it off to return to the classic layout - Add **Restore Reading Session** to reopen your last feed, post and nearby reading position after iOS closes Apollo, including feed and comment sorting (#1441: @Thetromboneman1) - On by default under Media → Browsing; explicit links and notifications take priority, and turning it off deletes the saved session - Add a **Setup Assistant** for new installations to connect or restore, choose Classic, Balanced or Full Featured preferences, select appearance, and review before applying (#1401: @jordanearle) - Existing users can open it from Apollo Reborn settings with Keep My Settings selected; updating does not automatically apply a preset - Rework **Gallery View** with faster opening, pinch-to-resize tiles including a denser four-column layout, and native press-and-hold menus in the grid and fullscreen viewer (#1389, #1434: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII) - Sports clips can play silently in the grid, newly visible tiles start reliably, and returning from a fullscreen image no longer leaves a black screen - Open **Gallery View** for All Saved or a selected **Saved category**, with empty categories shown without an endless spinner (#1440: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Rebuild **Recently Read** as a native Apollo feed that follows your post layout, thumbnails, text size, themes, swipe actions and menus (#1442: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Open it from its own row on your profile, switch its layout without changing other feeds, clear the history, or remove individual posts - Add **Recently Visited** subreddits to Search, with configurable section order and limits under Subreddits settings (#1404: @IllIIllIllIllII) - History clears on restart or account change and is not saved to backups - Add **Add Downvote Tap** under Posts & Feeds → Info Row so tapping a score can cycle through upvote, downvote and no vote; off by default (#1403: @AcornElf) - Add a **Subreddit Icon** switch to Compact and Immersive subreddit header layouts, updating the preview and live header together (#1426: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Feature seasonal icons in **Daily Spotlight** around holidays, including Apollo's original holiday icons; the spotlight now shows six picks (#1390, #1245: @icpryde, @IllIIllIllIllII) - Tint **Apollo Reborn maintainer usernames** purple in posts, comments and the Inbox, while retaining their real profiles and normal moderator indicators (#1411: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Make **Bug Reports** attach a removable debug log automatically, and mask usernames, account details, links and sensitive values before logs are exported or shared (#1422, #1423: @icpryde) - Export Debug Logs now shares a file that can be attached on GitHub; subreddit names, post/comment IDs and diagnostic details remain readable
### Performance
- Reduce unnecessary **API-Key-Free** requests by fetching subscriptions in larger pages and, with Reduce Rate Limiting on, batching feed avatars by page; interrupted subscription refreshes keep the existing list (#1416: @icpryde) - Deleted or unavailable Bluesky previews stop repeatedly fetching themselves and using Reddit requests as a fallback
### Fixes
- Refine **Duo navigation** with steadier feed positions and search bars when columns change, a smoother subreddit drawer, correct Home/Popular/All restoration, and Reddit links opened from Settings routed to Posts (#1470: @nnastasi) - Resume videos that were playing before folding or unfolding, covering both shared Reddit videos and direct-player media - Center **folded Duo title pills** in the usable header and keep composer text clear of the right-hand system strip, with correct wrapping and height through folding and unfolding (#1480: @jordanearle) - Keep the same **Duo comments thread** when returning from a linked subreddit after rotation or folding, and let the drawer return to an older retained feed correctly (#1464: @jordanearle) - Correct **Duo video autoplay** around the side rail and both columns' navigation bars (#1466: @kiliantyler) - Keep **View All Comments** visible inside its Duo comments pane when opening a specific comment (#1468: @d0lb33) - Stop the hidden **subreddit index** swallowing favorite taps and scrolling near the stars on Duo (#1469: @kiliantyler) - Open **native action menus** from controls moved into UIKit's overflow menu instead of silently dismissing without showing the actions (#1474: @kiliantyler) - Keep loading **API-Key-Free Inbox** rows when looking up a reply's quoted parent fails, showing the messages without that quote (#1455: @icpryde, @DeltAndy123) - Keep **API-Key-Free infinite scrolling** retryable after Reddit returns a rate limit or block page, rather than treating the refusal as the end of the feed (#1424: @icpryde) - Load the next feed page when **Hide Read** hides every loaded post, including with Infinite Scrolling off (#1412: @icpryde) - Fix **Reddit image uploads** becoming broken links when Imgur is selected, single-photo comment uploads failing, and synthetic album links in comments (#1402, #1406: @jordanearle, @IllIIllIllIllII) - Previously broken uploads still need to be uploaded again - Give **inline comment images and GIFs** Copy Image, Save Image and Share actions, and open loaded images fullscreen without a second loading fade (#1400: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Show the correct **image, GIF, video and album menus** when pressing and holding media inside a post, including Save All Media for albums (#1435: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Fix a crash when opening a **compact album** from its long-press preview (#1398: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Fix crashes while **feed videos** wait to play and while **deleted comments** are being prepared (#1428, #1450: @Thetromboneman1) - Keep a playing **feed video's sound and mute icon** in step when opening its post, including with the phone's silent switch on (#1425: @icpryde) - Stop **rich link cards** shifting the feed or changing their image crop after voting (#1457: @icpryde) - Open **Find in Comments** from the Liquid Glass post menu with its search field, keyboard and result navigation working correctly (#1446: @icpryde) - Keep a collapsed **feed search bar** hidden when returning from the fullscreen image viewer (#1447: @Thetromboneman1) - Bring back the complete **Liquid Glass tab bar** after swiping back from Edit Profile, including its glass background (#1431: @icpryde) - Refresh **subreddit icons and banners** from current Reddit artwork instead of retaining older images (#1396: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Preserve **usernames in comment and post headers** by shortening flair first, while keeping timestamps and other trailing details visible (#1366: @AcornElf) - Open **Reddit social links** on profiles directly in Apollo instead of the browser (#1407: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Explain why **Notifications settings** are unavailable when no notification backend is configured, instead of spinning forever (#1399: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Open **Poll, Media, Link and Text** post shortcuts in the correct editor even when the composer finishes preparing after its sheet appears (#1414: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Keep the separator below **Home's first post** visible after switchi…

item.title: Apollo v3.9.0
item.description:
Apollo 3.9.0 | Apollo-Reborn-3.9.0
### Features
- Add an **in-app update prompt**: from the next release on, Apollo Reborn checks for updates once a day and, when one is out, lets you send it to AltStore, SideStore, Feather, or FlareStore or download the IPA, with the release notes a tap away (#1343: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Tap **Later** or **Skip this version** to put it off, check any time with **Check for Updates** (About), or turn off **Automatic Update Checks** (Privacy, on by default); jailbreak installs don't check - What's New now shows the app icon you picked instead of the default one - Open the **subreddit switcher** as a native sheet when you tap a feed's title, with search, your favorites, and live results, instead of the small floating dropdown; typing a multireddit like apple+iphone still works (#1313, #1387: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Press and hold the **Posts** tab to open it while a feed is open, now on Liquid Glass too, and the search field stays in place as you scroll the sheet - Add a **Liquid Glass** switch (Interface → Appearance, on by default) so Liquid Glass builds can use Apollo's classic look without installing a different IPA; quit and reopen Apollo for the change to apply (#1384: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Shown on Liquid Glass builds on iOS 26 and later, except inside LiveContainer; while it's off, Liquid Glass-only options are hidden - Add a **Minimize** Hide Style for **Hide Bars on Scroll** (Interface → Tab Bar, Liquid Glass) that shrinks the tab bar into a small glass pill showing the current tab as you scroll, like Safari; tap the pill or scroll back up to bring the full bar back (#1349, #1384: @IllIIllIllIllII) - With any Hide Style on Liquid Glass, a tab bar or header hidden by scrolling now slides back in when you open a page or go back or forward, and the tab bar no longer comes back on its own after 30 seconds - Add **Reduce Rate Limiting** (Accounts & API Keys → Experimental, off by default) so **API-Key-Free** accounts hit Reddit's request limit less often: profile pictures load in batches without their collectible frames, Community Highlights refresh every 30 minutes instead of every 2, and your sign-in is checked less often (#1369: @icpryde) - Apollo offers it once: when you sign in without an API key, or, if you're already signed in, the first time you hit the limit - Even with it off, API-Key-Free accounts skip repeated account requests at launch and when you come back to the app, Community Highlights wait out a rate limit, and your own profile no longer shows "has been banned" during one - Add **Kagi** to the Search tab's **Search With** menu for Kagi subscribers: paste your Kagi Session Link once, then search Reddit through Kagi with the same result cards, Read More, and filters as Google, plus each post's score, comments, and age right away (#1305: @nickclyde) - Each page of results counts as one search on your Kagi plan; change or remove the link under Accounts & API Keys → Kagi Search - Add **Open via Nitter** (Open in App → X / Twitter, off by default) to open X and Twitter links on a Nitter instance you pick from a live list or enter yourself, so you can read posts and profiles without an X account (#1334: @nickclyde) - Shared and copied links stay on x.com - Open **Edit Profile** (your profile's ••• menu) inside Apollo on iOS 16 and later, signed in as the current account and styled with your theme, instead of in Safari, which often wasn't signed in (#1367: @icpryde) - API-key accounts without a **Reddit Web Sign-In** are asked to sign in once first - Add **True Black Keyboard** (Interface → Display & Navigation, off by default) to make the keyboard's background pure black for OLED screens, in dark mode, light mode, or always (#1316: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Add **Settings Icon Theme** (Settings → Appearance → Other, Light by default) to show settings icons as colored symbols on dark tiles, like iOS Settings in dark mode, either always (Dark) or only in dark mode (System) (#1377: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Pixel Pals now gets a rounded-square icon with your current pet, and the main Settings list drops its duplicate Apollo Ultra row (it's still under About) - Add a **User Profiles** settings page that brings Profile Layout, **Show User Profile Pictures**, and **Profile Picture Shape** together, with a live sample comment showing how profile pictures look (#1352: @IllIIllIllIllII) - Show User Profile Pictures and Profile Picture Shape move here from Interface → Display & Navigation - Reorganize **Subreddits** settings into Subreddit List, Subreddit Appearance, and Search Tab Sources, and redesign **Subreddit List Sections** (formerly Subreddit Sections) with a preview that looks like your real subreddit list (#1350, #1351: @IllIIllIllIllII) - **Show Subreddit Icons** moves here from Apollo's Appearance settings, and Section Order rows now drag by their handle - Also fixes subreddit list rows keeping the previous light or dark mode's colors with **Subreddit List Enhancements** off - Rework **Customize Action Menus** (Interface → Menus, formerly Action Menus) with clearer descriptions, a summary only on menus you've changed, **All Menus** showing where each action is hidden, and a **Reset Menu…** that can reset just the order (#1282, #1323, #1368: @AcornElf, @icpryde) - Touch-and-hold menus on posts and comments now follow your layout too, so hidden actions stay hidden and the order matches the ••• menu - Brings back **Remind Me In…** in the ••• menus on posts and comments on Liquid Glass, and lets you hide or move it - Add a **Comment Link** option to **Share as Image**: Include Link becomes a **Link** menu with No Link, Post Link, or Comment Link when you share a comment, and comment GIFs shared as video carry the chosen link too (#1278: @Thetromboneman1) - If Include Link was on, it carries over as Post Link - Add tile size buttons to **Gallery View** (the − and + magnifying glasses at the top) to switch between four tile sizes, from a denser grid to a single column; your choice is remembered (#1357: @jordanearle) - Write **Apollo AI** summaries in your language even when the post, article, or comments are in another one, with a new **Language** setting (Apollo AI → Summaries, Device Default by default) (#1362: @icpryde) - Summaries saved before this update are written again the next time you open their thread - Add **Custom Headers** to Apollo AI's Custom provider, for services that need extra request headers, such as the `x-opencode-session` header OpenCode Go now asks for (#1286: @icpryde) - Start a **crosspost**'s title as the original post's title, like reddit.com does, with an (x) to clear it; long titles now wrap onto up to five lines instead of being cut off (#1290: @icpryde) - Show the newest commenter's **profile picture** next to their name in the follow-thread **Live Activity** when **Show User Profile Pictures** is on (#1296: @icpryde) - Needs a self-hosted Notification Backend with avatar support - Add **Witching Hour** and **Count Helios**, two Halloween icons, to the Helios icon pack (#1378: @IllIIllIllIllII)
### Performance
- Use less memory for very large images in **Gallery View**, Image Chest albums, and Chat, which now load at the size they're shown instead of at full resolution (#1320: @ryannair05)
### Fixes
- Fix crashes when adding or removing a **favorite** on the Subreddits list, while writing a **Media** post (for example after changing its flair), and when swiping between pages of the fullscreen **media viewer** (#1336: @icpryde) - Fix Apollo crashing when you switch accounts with the **Inbox** open, and a rare crash when the Inbox is closed right after it opens (#1284, #1379: @icpryde) - Fix very long **text posts** showing a blank body at the largest text sizes, or after Apollo had been open a while (#1381: @icpryde) - Fix **Continue with Google** doing nothing and **Continue with Apple** showing an error on Reddit's sign-in page; both now open Google's or Apple's sign-in in a sheet, …
